S1214.reason: VCLT Article 7 presumes heads of state, heads of government and foreign ministers may perform all acts of conclusion without full powers, and heads of mission may adopt treaty texts; B’s “only” is too narrow.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction lets every State prosecute a defined set of grave crimes with no territorial or nationality link, and it does not extend to every international crime.

S1059.reason: In inter-State arbitration the parties appoint the members; a compulsory restricted list or appointment of the whole tribunal by a third party is not the general rule.
